values.note: CAMPER-REPORTED RATE (RV Life review, stay 10/2025): $25 a night for a back-in travel-trailer site with power and water, no sewer. The Village of Decatur has no web page of its own; call to confirm.

fees.source: https://campgrounds.rvlife.com/api/reviews/park/259043 (review: 'stayed 10/2025 | price $25 USD a night ... Travel Trailer | site 0 back_in | power 1 water yes sewer no'), read 2026-11-04; camper-reported because the operator has no web page

note: Village of Decatur park on the Missouri River at the edge of town (lower camping area along the river, upper loop by the ballfields); boat ramp and fish-cleaning station. A 2021 reviewer found it full of long-term campers who 'book for a couple months at a time', so call ahead in season. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $25 a night (RV Life review, October 2025). --Claude
summary: No Village of Decatur website exists (no domain answers; Burt County tourism lists the park with phone 402-349-5360 and no website link); VisitNebraska behind Cloudflare, unread. Priced from a dated camper report ($25, 10/2025, power+water) since the village has no page. Riverview confirmed on imagery (the lower area's lane runs between its pads and the bank). Other derived groups left (no official page to confirm or contradict).
flags: WEBSITE: stored is the VisitNebraska listing (state tourism; Cloudflare-blocked to me). The village has no website I could find (decaturne.org/.com, decaturnebraska.com/.org, villageofdecatur.com and *.nebraska.gov variants do not resolve). Burt County's tourism page (https://burtcountytourism.com/stay) also lists it, with the same phone 402-349-5360 - phone OK.

LONG-STAY / BOOKING CONFLICT: Campendium review (May 20, 2021): 'You will be lucky to find a spot since the place has many long term campers. Be sure to call for reservations. Appeared folks book for a couple months at a time and pull the campers in on the weekends. Lots of empty sites yet they were all reserved.' The newer RV Life review (stay 10/2025): 'There was only one other camper here when I was'. The stored booking (reservable false, fcfs always, derived from note prose) contradicts the 2021 'call for reservations'; both are secondary, so not changed - a call to 402-349-5360 would settle reservations and how much of the park is seasonal.

WATERFRONT riverview holds: the lower area's gravel back-in pads branch off the west side of the lane that runs down to the river point; the lane and a 20-30 m grass strip lie between them and the Missouri bank (lane blocks on-water). The upper loop is ~100 m inland among trees and houses. No pad seen on the river side of the lane.
PIN OK: stored 42.00385,-96.24430 sits on a residential lot at the south edge of the park, ~90 m from the upper loop; a pin on the loop (~42.0045,-96.2450) would be tidier.
Site count 50 and 30/50 A rest on note prose; ParkAdvisor (directory) says 25 sites, all electric and water. Unconfirmed either way.
